readers.why: Reads any key: one path loads the key's text, compares no token and inserts a CNameListCulture (PR #303, registry-fields.md 'Readers of any key').
Compares the key's text with `generic` and looks it up in the ship sizes: not an entry reader, and its keys are not enumerated tokens.
The same key-text compare and lookup as CNameListShipClass.

`stages` reads its block in a statement loop (ReadSimpleStatement) that the walk follows, so the loop is not cut. `category` is read by its token converter, and `stages` by no call of its own: the loop inserts each stage.
Its default path calls two member readers; the export does not follow CSwappableBase::ReadMember.
Its default path calls CAgreementTermData::SetPresetData before CPersistent::ReadMember.
A value reader: it tests the value token (a text or a block of options), not a key.
The event instance of the same value reader.
The root reader of `common/asteroid_belts`, which Native answers Complete with the same keys.

`upgrades_to` tests the value's token first: a block reads a string list into +0x140, any other value appends one string to it. `alliance_ship_design` reads a Boolean into +0x114 and then runs the same test, so the test is not the first thing that its path does and neither branch is proved (registry-fields.md 'The reader export').
`hero_ship` tests the value's token first: a block is a persistent object read, any other value a Boolean.
`fire_only_once` stores whether the value's token is `yes`: it reads the value, so it is a store and not a presence marker.
